metadata.source: FDA, Guidance for Industry: Registration and Listing of Cosmetic Product Facilities and Products, Appendix A
metadata.codes_note: Codes follow the appendix numbering (group 2 digits + letter + leave-on/rinse-off or application digit), the same pattern as the SPL IG's own examples (01B, 01D1, 14D1).
metadata.display_names_note: SPL needs FDA's exact display name (IG 3.4.3.4). The guide shows three different styles, so these are a best guess in the style of IG 3.4.3.5 until FDA's terminology file is checked.
metadata.code_17_note: Group 17 (Other preparations) has no subcategories; '17' is used as its code, unconfirmed.
